items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe, I’m very pleased to have Mike Davis with me... [INTERVIEWEE] Good to be with you, Monk.

ctx.x: Mike was interviewed via Zoom on April 1, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe, I’m very pleased to have Mike Davis with me for the Fillius Jazz Archive. Welcome, sir.
Good to be with you, Monk. Thanks so much for having me.
